title: LandlordGuard Installment Fee Tenure Credit Table
content:
Larkspur Mutual credits the installment fee on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy for the landlord's time insured on the building.

**Table.** The installment-fee tenure credit looks at whole months from the original effective date to the charge date: 120 months or more take 1.50 USD off; 60 to 119 months take 0.75 USD off; fewer than 60 months take nothing off.

The tenure credit is taken off in the fee adjustment of the installment fee.

| Whole months from the original effective date to the charge date | Installment-fee tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 1.50 USD off |
| 60 to 119 | 0.75 USD off |
| fewer than 60 | nothing |

The original effective date is the policy's first inception date, not the start of the current term.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates, charge date 1 April 2025)

| Original effective date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 April 2015 | 120 | 1.50 USD |
| 2 April 2015 | 119 | 0.75 USD |
| 1 April 2020 | 60 | 0.75 USD |
| 2 April 2020 | 59 | nothing |
